newsitem.title: UK: Scottish islanders fail in German buyback bid.
newsitem.headline: Scottish islanders fail in German buyback bid.

text.p: Scottish islanders on Monday failed in a bid to buy their remote Hebridean home from its German owner.
But islanders on Eigg said they were still determined to raise the two million pound ($3.37 million) asking price and end what they said was years of misery at the hands of absentee landlords.
Selling agents said German artist Marlin Eckhard Maruma had considered the offers unacceptable. But Eigg is to stay on the market.
The islanders had raised nearly 300,000 pounds ($505,400) in an appeal and also won backing to get additional funding from Britain's National Lottery.
Eigg Heritage Trust secretary Maggie Fyffe vowed to fight on: "I cannot stress strongly enough that this is by no way the end of the road for us. If anything, it simply makes us more determined."
